question: Ramesh goes to his office by scooter at the speed of 45 km/hr and reaches 10 minutes earlier. If he goes at the speed 30 km/hr, then he reaches 10 minutes late. What will be the speed of the scooter to reach on the usual time?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed when reaching 10 minutes early = 45 km/hr

Speed when reaching 10 minutes late = 30 km/hr

Difference in time = 20 minutes = 20/60 hours = 1/3 hours

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Let the usual time to reach the office be t hours and the distance be d km.

For the first scenario (reaching 10 minutes early):

d = 45 × (t - 1/6)

For the second scenario (reaching 10 minutes late):

d = 30 × (t + 1/6)
